notes.text: New: Incognito Keyboard privacy setting disables Google keyboard from learning words
New: Thundermail interim screen when adding an account
Changed: Selected sort option now shows an indicator in the sort menu
Fixed: Messages could scroll horizontally when content fit the screen
Fixed: Thread deletion confirmation incorrectly said only one message would be deleted
Fixed: Notification actions were difficult to scroll and reorder on small screen
Fixed: Show Headers collapsed multi-line email headers into a single line
Fixed: Notification previews displayed HTML entities and markup instead of clean text
Fixed: Select Image icon was hard to see in dark theme
Fixed: Printed message headers always used US date format instead of local format
Fixed: Splash screen truncated the Thunderbird name on small displays
